description: Bases de TypeScript : types primitifs, tableaux/objets, inférence, unions, alias, fonctions, génériques, classes et interfaces.

questions.prompt: What are the base types & primitives in TypeScript?
How do you type Arrays and Objects in TypeScript?
What is Type Inference in TypeScript?
questions.answer_text:
TypeScript automatically detects the type based on the assigned value, so you don't always need to write types explicitly.

Exemple :
let city = "Rabat"; // inferred as string
// city = 10  ❌ error
